title: WaterColor "Be Still" 25 Rain Lily Lane
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Per WaterColor HOA, all guests 5 years of age or older must be included in your adult guest total in order to receive wristbands to access amenities and pools. This home is allotted 14 wristbands.- Located in the Lake District of WaterColor- Access to community pools, nature trails, and dune lakes- Conveniently located near Publix & restaurants- Private Pool (complimentary pool heating available October 1-May 1)- 6- Passenger Low-Speed Vehicle- 6 adult bikes- 2 Outdoor Fireplaces- Gas Grill- Parking for 4 Vehicles- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutGuests staying in WaterColor will have access to the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club. It features a new main pool and lounge area, second pool deck with additional lounge seating, and third pool with zero-entry, as well an enhanced WaterColor Grill, and new sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico.DETAILS: Reset with a refreshing getaway at Be Still, a peaceful escape nestled in beloved WaterColor. Sleeping 14, this 6-bedroom, 5.5-bathroom home is the ultimate Emerald Coast retreat for groups or large families looking to unwind from the daily grind. Imagine tranquil days cooling off in the private pool or relaxing on the spacious porches, and enjoy access to the community’s resort-style amenities, including multiple neighborhood pools, Camp WaterColor’s lazy river, and the WaterColor Beach Club—only an 11-minute stroll away!Natural light, pale coastal colors, and a flowing layout create a graceful escape on the first level of this 3-story home. Inside the great room, dark wood beams accentuate the golden chandelier above the living area, where 2 striped club chairs and a wraparound sofa invite restful evenings watching TV. The kitchen serves as a central hub, with an expansive center island that seats 6, ample prep space, and premium appliances—including a top-of-the-line Wolf range. The formal dining table for 8 is steps away, and beyond is a sunny nook with an L-shaped sofa and fireplace. Head onto the screened porch to discover a serene sanctuary with cushioned furniture, an outdoor fireplace, a TV, and an overhead fan. Flourishing greenery and a private pool with a melodious water feature welcome guests into the backyard for sun-kissed relaxation. Around the side of the home, a natural gas grill and an outdoor table with 2 chairs and 2 benches await barbecues. A charming mudroom equipped with a stacked washer and dryer offers ease after beach and pool days. When it’s time to retire, rest comfortably in the beautiful primary bedroom featuring a king bed and private bathroom.The second level includes an elegant desk space and a screened-in porch with soft seating, a porch swing, and ceiling fans. There are 3 guest bedrooms to choose from, each with a king bed and private bathroom—1 of which includes direct access to the porch.Kids will love the third-level hangout, featuring a wraparound couch and TV. There are 2 bunk rooms, each with a queen bed and a full-over-full bunk bed.Experience a serene getaway at WaterColor’s Be Still! Parking for 4 vehicles makes it easy to explore—or take advantage of the 6-passenger low-speed vehicle and 6 complimentary adult bikes. The nearest beach access is available at the WaterColor Beach Club. Book today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (SLEEPS 14):FIRST FLOOR:-Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlySECOND FLOOR:-Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only-Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only-Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlyTHIRD FLOOR:-Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed and Full-over-Full Bunk Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo-Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed and Full-over-Full Bunk Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Additional Living Area: Living Room
